label: Nonheap whole in Metaphysics H.6: The explanatory target at 1045a8–14: a plurality of parts whose…
definition: The explanatory target at 1045a8–14: a plurality of parts whose whole is not merely a heap but something besides its parts. This source condition is not silently equated with every fusion, a living organism, or the primitive Composite predicate used by the later Aquinas argument.
